svg.title: PAM-4 eye diagram with thresholds, eye heights and eye widths
svg.desc: Eye diagram of the receiver output at 50 m after a 5-tap FFE, over two unit intervals around the sampling instant. Four levels mu0 to mu3, three dashed decision thresholds theta0 to theta2 halfway between them, vertical arrows for the eye heights and horizontal arrows for the eye widths at each threshold. SER 8.3e-08.
